card.name: Decimal point inside numbers in tables
card.fires_on: The decimal point (or the space just before a number) in a decimal value such as 0.75, 5.95 or 2.1%. It is most common in dosing tables, concentrations and trial result percentages.

modes.description: The period inside a percentage in study results.
